blocking_compatibility_issue.issue: Native Code Mode wait termination closes the dynamic-tool RPC while the SDK command continues.
blocking_compatibility_issue.observed_08: Obsidian I1: native call cancelled 15:55:27 CST; SDK success 59/59 suites and 1190/1190 tests at 15:57:41 was absent from native history.
blocking_compatibility_issue.new_behavior: Deliver the actual SDK observation via native turn/start toolOutput; keep the thread; withhold earlier final; never rerun the SDK tool.
blocking_compatibility_issue.equivalence_limit: Recovery can add a native model turn and stores a named tool output envelope containing original call ID, arguments, error flag and exact output. This is an explicit adapter behavior, not strict stateless-API equivalence.
blocking_compatibility_issue.rejected_setting: code_mode_interrupt=false did not prevent terminate=true or retain late results.

completion_and_grading.sdk_completion_gate: run_cc_sdk.py:612-624 requires ResultMessage with is_error=false and no online-teacher error.
completion_and_grading.export: Patch and collected trajectory are saved in finally; incomplete remains incomplete.
completion_and_grading.formal_grade_gate: run_multi_turn_loop.py:964-995 skips grading on SDK/API execution errors when experiment_session is set.
completion_and_grading.existing_gap: A native cancelled subtool followed by successful native final previously looked like normal SDK completion; recovery addresses the observation loss before that final.

teacher_and_timeout.checkpoints: 20 completed main-agent tools, wait for inflight set empty, maximum 3 checks per actual attempt.
teacher_and_timeout.handoff: Only screened hint is added as hook context; original tool output stays intact.
teacher_and_timeout.accounting_detail: Runner timeout subtracts host teacher-service wait; report subtracts the SDK hook HTTP wait. Observed SDK waits exceeded service waits by about 0.3-0.6 seconds per check. No observed 08 attempt approached the 7200-second limit.
teacher_and_timeout.impact: Document timing definitions; no demonstrated score change from this small measurement difference.

usage_and_elapsed.attempt_elapsed: Driver elapsed_seconds includes setup, student and formal verifier. It is not pure model time.
usage_and_elapsed.student_active: SDK wall time minus online-teacher HTTP wait; includes SDK/tool execution overhead.
usage_and_elapsed.model_request_seconds: Sum of bridge HTTP request waiting time; can overlap across lanes and is not experiment makespan.
usage_and_elapsed.recovered_08_evals: Independent recovered elapsed values explicitly sum original student SDK wall plus recovered verifier wall; exclude stop wait and must not be silently pooled with driver whole-attempt wall.
usage_and_elapsed.shared_HM: Shared first-round tokens/outcome are counted once, branch references are separately represented.
